cohort: The study describes a single antenatal patient presenting with COVID-19, a prosthetic aortic valve, on warfarin with elevated INR, and severe pre-eclampsia.
finding: The case illustrates the significant clinical challenge and lack of standard protocols for managing antenatal patients with COVID-19 and multiple unoptimized comorbid medical illnesses.
mod_finding: The patient was posted for an emergency cesarean section due to the complex interplay of her severe medical conditions.
